summary: Re-observation of the R-4 journey after the WI-10002717 fix changed control-anchor.ts (now 49a6b9c45c), which made docs/evidence/p015-r4-real-backend-operational-2026-09-23.json source-stale. The maintained driver (scripts/verify-identities-r4.mjs, real-backend branch) ran inside verify-tauri-headless.sh against an isolated Tauri webview and an isolated, freshly migrated Postgres (workspace verify-tauri-isolated-90). The launching shell recorded HEAD 2633f4772ec2 with every R-4 source path's working-tree blob equal to its HEAD blob at start and unchanged at end. The driver drove the rendered /settings/identities page with pointer clicks: it selected the owned roster agent, reviewed the backend diff, switched identity through the real identity-management backend and saw change-requested then applied after the host acknowledged, then rolled back through the same path and saw change-requested then applied again. All 36 steps passed (0 failed checks), with realBackend=true, syntheticMutationResponses=false and hostActivationProven=true. The raw driver artifact is docs/evidence/p015-r4-real-backend-2026-09-23b.json (sha256 below); this file is its operational-test-evidence envelope.
timeBasis: startedAt and finishedAt are the launching shell's own `date -u` stamps around the whole headless run (boot, drill, teardown).

subject.note: A disposable owner seeded in the verifier's isolated database. The UI, the identity-management route and the host activation acknowledgement are the production code paths, not mocks.

rawArtifact.redaction: The driver's serializeEvidence (redactIdentityLeaks) scrubbed home-directory paths at write time; the builder refuses an artifact containing the home prefix. Copied byte-for-byte; no post-hoc edit.

replication.expect: exit 0 and evidence.json with status=pass, realBackend=true, hostActivationProven=true, observed covering real-switch-applied and real-rollback-applied

assertions.evidence: Steps owned-agent-visible, identity-library-visible, owned-agent-selected and real-select-identity are present and their checks passed. Every transition used a real pointer click on an element scrolled into the viewport (the driver refuses a target outside the viewport).

Steps real-review-switch, real-review-response and real-review-diff-visible. real-review-response is action 'preview', HTTP 200, body ok:true with 103 diff row(s) (first field configuration.roles[0].stack[0]); the diff came from the identity-management backend, not client-side state.

Steps real-switch-change-requested, then real-switch-host-ack, then real-switch-applied. The applied step records controlGeneration 1 = controlDeliveredGeneration 1, activation status 'applied', failure null, applied specificationRevision 29c66fa4079b (equal to the switch response's revision).

Steps real-rollback-change-requested, real-rollback-host-ack and real-rollback-applied. The applied step records controlGeneration 2 = controlDeliveredGeneration 2, activation status 'applied', failure null, applied specificationRevision 34d820c36264 (a different revision from the switch).

realBackend=true, syntheticMutationResponses=false. The fetch observer was installed (eval:observe-real-fetch returned p015-r4-real-fetch-observer) and captured both mutations: real-review-response is action 'preview' HTTP 200; real-switch-response is action 'switch' HTTP 200, stack ["domain:research-steward"], delivery relaunch-with-carry.

notProven: Failure-banner rendering on the REAL backend. The failure/retry path is proven by the controlled-response run (docs/evidence/p015-r4-controlled-ui-2026-09-20.json), not this one.
